summary: Journey Page Redesign with 7 Apple-inspired UX improvements - All features verified working. Backend 10/10 tests pass. Frontend UI testing complete with all key components functional.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/programs/{id} returns journey_rail with stages array and active/pulse fields
Backend: Stanford has coach_replied stage due to prior coach reply interaction
Backend: Pulse indicator values are valid (active, cooling, cold, neutral)
Backend: GET /api/programs/{id}/journey returns timeline array with events
Backend: Manual journey_stage override marks all prior stages as completed
Backend: POST /api/programs/compare returns enriched data for multiple programs
Backend: Compare with empty program_ids returns empty array
Backend: POST /api/programs/{id}/mark-replied requires non-empty note (400 on empty)
Backend: mark-replied creates coach_reply interaction and sets has_coach_reply=true
Backend: All programs have valid board_group values
Frontend: UCLA Journey shows Getting Started Checklist (empty state) with 4 steps, 1 completed
Frontend: Stanford Journey shows Celebration Hero 'Coach Johnson is interested!' with action buttons
Frontend: Progress Rail displays 6 stages (Added/Outreach/Replied/Visit/Offer/Committed)
Frontend: Progress Rail supports manual override via stage click (toast confirms update)
Frontend: Pulse indicator shows correct status (Active for Stanford, New for UCLA)
Frontend: Conversation Timeline shows coach reply as left-aligned green bubble
Frontend: At a Glance sidebar shows stage badge, stats, coach info, AI tip button
Frontend: Floating Action Bar visible with Email/Log/Replied/Follow-up buttons
Frontend: Compare button navigates to /compare with school pre-selected via query param
Frontend: Compare page shows school selector, search, comparison cards with mini rail
Frontend: Compare page allows adding schools via search dropdown
Frontend: Back button navigates from Journey to /pipeline
Frontend: Log Interaction form opens from FAB with Type/Outcome/Date/Notes fields
Frontend: Mark as Replied form opens from FAB with Note textarea

context_for_next_testing_agent: Journey page redesign complete at /journey/{programId}. Key features: (1) Visual Progress Rail with 6 stages clickable for manual override, (2) Getting Started Checklist for empty state schools, (3) Conversation-style Timeline with left/right bubbles, (4) At a Glance contextual sidebar, (5) Celebration Hero when coach replies, (6) Floating Action Bar at bottom, (7) Compare page at /compare. All data-testid attributes present for testing. Stanford (prog_3cbb4ff4df51) shows active state with coach reply. UCLA (prog_4319d98c1c3b) shows empty state with checklist.

feature_verification.progress_rail: 6-stage rail (Added/Outreach/Replied/Visit/Offer/Committed) with clickable stages for manual override
feature_verification.pulse_indicator: Shows relationship health: Active (green), Cooling (amber), Cold (red), New (gray)
feature_verification.getting_started_checklist: 4-step checklist for empty state schools with progress bar
feature_verification.celebration_hero: Celebratory banner when coach replies with 'Send Thank You', 'Schedule Call', 'Log a Note' buttons
feature_verification.conversation_timeline: Chat bubble layout - left=coach (green), right=you (pink), center=milestones
feature_verification.at_a_glance_sidebar: Stage badge, stats (Outreach sent, Events), Coach info, AI tip, More details expander
feature_verification.floating_action_bar: Sticky bottom bar with Email, Log, Replied, Follow-up buttons
feature_verification.compare_page: Side-by-side school comparison with mini rails, stats, search to add schools
